2610.13605.title: zip2zip++: Towards Inference-Time Token Compression with Minimal Quality Loss
2610.13605.paper_summary: Dynamic vocabularies built on-the-fly via Lempel-Ziv-Welch (LZW) compression let a language model represent the same text in fewer tokens, but prior work shows that this efficiency comes at a cost to reasoning and perplexity. We show that this quality gap is not a fundamental price of compression but can be substantially closed through targeted improvements to the compression layer and LZW codec, without modifying the underlying pretrained language model. Our analysis reveals four key issues: (1) LZW's compression algorithm creates an implicit conflict between the input embedding and the output embedding, a tension that a single shared embedding cannot resolve; (2) naively applying RoPE to LZW-compressed sequences ignores that merged tokens can span multiple tokens; (3) merging certain tokens (notably digits) disproportionately hurts downstream accuracy; and (4) dynamic vocabularies introduce an inherent segmentation ambiguity that confounds standard evaluation. We address these through decoupled input/output dynamic embedding layer, size-aware RoPE positioning, and a modified LZW codec supporting selective merges and multi-view segmentations. Across four models, our recipe improves perplexity on every corpus we evaluated as well as mathematical reasoning accuracy, closing roughly half the quality gap between zip2zip and the uncompressed baseline at a similar compression ratio on general text. This represents a significant step toward lossless adaptive-vocabulary compression for language models.
2610.13605.paper_summary_zh: 動態詞彙透過 Lempel-Ziv-Welch (LZW) 壓縮即時建立，使語言模型能以更少的標記表示相同的文本，但先前的研究顯示，這種效率是以推理和困惑度為代價的。我們表明，這種質量差距並不是壓縮的根本代價，而是可以通過對壓縮層和 LZW 編解碼器的有針對性改進來大幅縮小，而無需修改底層的預訓練語言模型。我們的分析揭示了四個關鍵問題：(1) LZW 的壓縮算法在輸入嵌入和輸出嵌入之間創造了一種隱含的衝突，這種緊張關係是單一共享嵌入無法解決的；(2) 盲目地將 RoPE 應用於 LZW 壓縮序列忽略了合併的標記可以跨越多個標記；(3) 合併某些標記（特別是數字）會不成比例地損害下游準確性；以及 (4) 動態詞彙引入了一種固有的分段模糊性，這使得標準評估變得困難。我們通過解耦的輸入/輸出動態嵌入層、大小感知的 RoPE 位置以及支持選擇性合併和多視角分段的修改 LZW 編解碼器來解決這些問題。在四個模型中，我們的方案在每個評估的語料庫上改善了困惑度以及數學推理的準確性，在一般文本上以相似的壓縮比縮小了 zip2zip 和未壓縮基線之間約一半的質量差距。這代表著朝向無損自適應詞彙壓縮的語言模型邁出了重要的一步。
